description: Raw flood impact extractions from news and agency sources for the Iowa Flood Compendium, produced with the published prompt in news_extraction_prompt.md and human review. sources = every article consulted (used, rejected, unreachable). records = structured impact observations referencing source_id. search_log = per-episode outcome of each source-hunting round, so searched-but-uncovered episodes are distinguishable from never-searched ones.

No news coverage of flood impacts in Cherokee/Clay/Dickinson/O'Brien counties for May 1-17, 2024 was found; results were dominated by the June 2024 event.

KTIV 6/17/2024: Dickinson County emergency 5 mph rule (approved 6/17, effective 6/18) and ~10 gpm sewage discharge into West Lake Okoboji - 2 records.
